subject: Core Mathematics
title: Vectors I
inquiry_questions: Where are vectors used in real-life situations?

outcomes.text: explain vector and scalar quantities with illustrations
use vector notations in different ways
represent vectors geometrically in different situations
identify equivalent vectors in different situations
determine column vectors in different situations
determine position vectors in different situations
work out magnitude of a vector in different situations
determine the midpoint of a vector in different situations
determine translation vector as a transformation
appreciate the use of vectors in real-life situations

coreCompetencies:
Learning to learn: As the learner uses charts and grids to practise addition of vectors.
Self-efficacy: As the learner shares and uses resources from the immediate environment such as plane figures or flip charts to demonstrate equivalent vectors.
values:
Responsibility: As the learner uses resources from the immediate environment such as plane figures, flip charts and relate equivalent vectors.
Unity: As the learner searches and brainstorms on the meaning of the terms vector and scalar quantities and illustrates giving examples.
pcis:
Education for Sustainable Development - Environmental education as learners practice addition of vectors using charts and grids made from resources in the immediate environment.
Road safety: as the learner discusses the meaning of arrows and lines on roads and road signs in relation to movement on the roads to enhance safety.
notes: No allocation is printed in the unit table.
Baseline name Vectors is shortened; printed source name Vectors I is used in authored content.
